name: dsh-chat-window-fold
description: Chat window fold for the dsh web GUI: when the user scrolls to the bottom, older loaded chat pages beyond the recent 50 events are visually folded away (released on the next top-scroll expand); when the user scrolls to the very top, up to 50 earlier messages are appended with the viewport kept in place, again on every top-scroll until no more history exists. Event-cycle checkpoints (every 25 session events, from N=75 onward) gate the fold so window size stays below ~75 events on low-end machines. Configurable via row config (foldThreshold=50, foldCheckEvery=25). Mounted as a profile bundle; npm-publishable.

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js && node test/sandbox-load.test.cjs
